description: This source file implements a platform-independent utility function for creating an LPC Connector object within the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It primarily contains the implementation of the function `AnscCreateLpcConnector` that invokes the creation routine for the connector object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateLpcConnector(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new LPC Connector object handle using the provided context handles.
